title: Zimbabwean Traditional dance Tutorial (Mbakumba 01 - Basic Introduction)

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor uses an encouraging, structured approach, breaking down steps into component parts with distinct verbal counts and on-screen text aids. She combines clapping rhythms with footwork demonstrations, progressing from simple versions to variations with hops.

lesson_structure.note: Welcome greeting and introduction to the Mbakumba dance style.
Explanation of lesson breakdown into four weekly sections and dedication.
Detailed breakdown of Jeketera steps with on-screen count prompts.
Reviewing simple version, adding hop, and closing.
Dancing Jeketera to music with clapping and footwork.

steps_taught.name: Jeketera Basic
steps_taught.description: Two steps forward starting with the left foot, followed by three steps back.

steps_taught.name: Jeketera with Hop
steps_taught.description: Basic forward steps with rhythmic hopping patterns during the backward transition.

steps_taught.name: Mujibha Closing
steps_taught.description: Closing step featuring hopping backwards and arm movements.

what_works: On-screen text guides displaying counts and step names
Clear progression from simple steps to adding hops and music
what_hinders: Camera angle remains static from the front without rear-view demonstration

quotes.text: Today we're going to be exploring a polyrhythmic traditional dance
I have broken down our dance into four different sections
Two steps forward, three steps back
If you've made it this far taking part in this session, well done

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher speaks directly to camera introducing the dance topic with hand gestures.
Teacher demonstrates stepping forward and back with corresponding on-screen text overlays for counts.
Teacher performs hopping step variations while vocalizing rhythmic syllables.
Teacher demonstrates closing mujibha movement with arms raised and hopping backwards.

extraction.distinctive_method: Integrating traditional song lyrics and rhythmic vocal prompts (Gi-Ta-Ta) directly into the instructional counting method.
